module arbiter_06 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [3:0] req,
  input [3:0] lock,
  output [3:0] gnt
);

  reg [3:0] grant_reg;
  reg [3:0] grant_next;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      grant_reg <= 4'd0;
    end else begin
      grant_reg <= grant_next;
    end
  end

  assign gnt = grant_reg;

  always @(*) begin
    // Default assignment: no grant
    grant_next = 4'd0;

    // If any request is high and no lock is active, grant the first request
    if (req != 4'd0) begin
      if (grant_reg == 4'd0) begin
        // Grant the lowest priority request that is not locked
        if (req[0] && !lock[0]) begin
          grant_next = 4'd1;
        end else if (req[1] && !lock[1]) begin
          grant_next = 4'd2;
        end else if (req[2] && !lock[2]) begin
          grant_next = 4'd4;
        end else if (req[3] && !lock[3]) begin
          grant_next = 4'd8;
        end
      end else begin
        // If already granted, maintain the grant as long as the lock is active
        if ((grant_reg & lock) != 0) begin
          grant_next = grant_reg;
        end
      end
    end
  end

endmodule
